text: 1103 restores the required br-before-div assertion because the upstream change was backed out. Its small original change removed that assumption and checked text directly before the attachment root. The accepted test again uses root.previousSibling directly. Keep this test expectation tied to the editor revision and caret behavior rather than treating a br as a permanent cloud-file layout requirement. The upstream cause and full discussions remain unread; the outside-range original was read as context only.
title: Separate the cloud-editor caret expectation from upstream editor behavior
